dedupe_keys.name: usa road network graph and points of interest dataset

description: USA Road Network Graph and Points-of-Interest Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tenindra Abeywickrama (RIKEN Center for Computational Science). This dataset contains information related to the USA road network for evaluating the performance of POI search queries. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Copyright (C) OpenStreetMap Contributors. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
